model_kind: CatBoost symmetric-tree classifier giving the probability that an onset candidate of the Low band is a clear onset
runtime_decision: Embedded read-only in the DSP module and evaluated at each onset candidate of the Low band. A candidate is accepted when its probability reaches the operating threshold 0.42 (stored in rhythm_d_tables.h). The weights are fixed at build time; nothing is loaded, trained or adapted at run time.

training_data.music: Slakh2100-redux train split (806 tracks) and Groove MIDI train fold (303 clips): 1109 tracks, 3663.8 minutes
training_data.negatives: 360 synthetic stationary-noise streams of 60 s (white, pink and spectral slopes from -2 to 2, -70 to -5 dBFS; seeds 71000000 + k) and 1109 synthetic music-to-noise transition clips (seeds 73000000 + k)

selection: Slakh2100-redux validation split and Groove MIDI validation fold (312 tracks) were used to choose the feature set, the candidate window and the operating threshold; the model was not trained on them.

storage.policy: Split thresholds are 8-bit indices into per-feature sorted binary32 border tables, which is exact. The symmetric trees use the oblivious layout (one split per level, split k sets bit k of the leaf index), which is exact. Leaves are rounded half to even to int16 with one binary32 scale (absolute maximum / 32767, rounded to binary32 first) per tree and output. Splits, tree addition order, scale and bias are unchanged.
storage.reproduce: Export the source model to a float-threshold, float-leaf heap tree (format in BUILD.md), then run python dsp/plugins/analyzer/tree_models/compact_model.py rhythm_d_low.json --oblivious --leaves int16
